    G

    getFamilyMemberIndex(Scanner, String[]) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Asks for the name of a family member and finds that member, ignoring case, asking again until a name matches.
    getFamilyMemberName(Scanner, int) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Asks for and reads the name of one family member.
    getFamilyMembersRecords(Scanner, String[], char[][][]) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Gets the name, the uppers and the lowers of every family member and records them in the family member names array and the teeth array.
    getMenuOption(Scanner) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Displays the menu and reads the option chosen, asking again until it is one of the four options (in upper or lower case).
    getNumberOfFamilyMembers(Scanner) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Asks for and reads the number of people in the family, asking again until it is between 1 and MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_FAMILY_MEMBERS.
    getTeethLayer(Scanner, String, String) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Reads one layer of teeth (the uppers or the lowers) of a family member, asking again until the string typed has at most MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_TEETH_PER_LAYER characters and every character is a tooth type (I, B or M, in upper or lower case).
    getToothLayer(Scanner) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Asks which tooth layer, upper or lower, asking again until the answer starts with U or L (in upper or lower case).
    getToothNumber(Scanner, char[]) - Static method in class FloridianToothRecords
    Asks for a tooth number in a row of teeth, asking again until the number is in the row and the tooth there is not already missing.
